Mahmud Ansari @ Abdul Mahmud Ansari vs The State Of Bihar
on 6 January, 2026
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.89074 of 2025
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-1921 Year-2021 Thana- Patna Complaint Case 
 Patna

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
======================================================
 Mahmud Ansari @ Abdul Mahmud Ansari S/O Md. Rahim Ansari Resident of
 Kenal Road, Dalmia, P.S- Dehri- on-Sone, District- Rohtas.

... ... P
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar
 2. M/S Sona Gold Agro Chem (Pvt) Ltd.

Through its Aurthorized Person Sri  Arun Kumar Mishra aged about 46 yrs, Son of Sri Rameshwar Mishra  having Regd. Office at 603, Ashiana Plaza, Budha Marg, P.S- Kotwali,
 Distt.- Patna.

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Ram Shankar Prasad  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Anil Kumar

= =====================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 06-01-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1921 of 2021 instituted for the offence under Sections 403, 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per allegation in the FIR, complainant carries a business of poultry foods and on good faith, he has supplied goods to the petitioner worth rs. 6,04,692/-.
It is further alleged that despite legal notice, petitioner has Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.89074 of 2025(2) dt.06-01-2026 neither returned the goods nor made any payment of the outstanding amount.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
Cognizance in this offence has been taken after more than three years, while it is punishable for three years.
It is a case of business transaction, so offence u/s 406 IPC is not attracted.
It is mentioned in para 3 of the petition that petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.
